info.name: Adobe Photoshop Actions Crop and Effects API
Adobe Photoshop Smart Crop to Product Subject

items.docs: Applies AI-powered smart cropping that identifies the main product or subject in an image and crops to keep it centered with configurable padding.

info.name: Adobe Photoshop Apply Depth Blur Effect

items.docs: Applies an AI-powered depth blur (bokeh) effect to an image, simulating a shallow depth of field. Configurable focal point, blur strength, focal range, grain, and haze parameters.
